feature: Operator control plane — full screen set
revision: v2 — dual-theme architecture (operator mode default; MetaBoy scoped to consumer playground)

themeArchitecture.decision: Two themes, NOT a per-session operator toggle.

operatorMode.usage: The entire admin console — dashboard, all CRUD, usage, audit. Legible dark shadcn surface with Earth GB accent hues. AA contrast, real Plex sizes, full tables.
operatorMode.rationale: A security + billing tool must be calm, legible, accessible. One default.

metaBoy.usage: Consumer-facing surfaces only: the hosted per-Paddock playground (primary), and optionally a dashboard-only vanity flourish. Operator-selectable PER PADDOCK (plain <-> MetaBoy).
metaBoy.rationale: Game Boy skin is delightful but fights data density. It lives where density is low and the product faces outward.
metaBoy.constraint: True multi-tenant theming is out of scope for v1; per-Paddock skin is in scope.

operatorMode.comment: Earth GB hues on a warm-neutral dark surface. This is the admin theme.

metaBoy.comment: Dot-matrix LCD device. Consumer theme only.

mono.usage: IDs, URLs, slugs, keys, numeric data (both themes)

keyframes.mmpulse: 1.6s (status dot pulse for down/alarm — used in both themes)

paramSpec.description: Array produced by the paramSchema editor; validated by reconstructGraph() server-side.

union.note: auto-generated per run; UI shows AUTO, never a field
value from trusted /upload/image keyed by name; UI shows upload slot

securityInvariants: Only promoted inputs are caller-editable; everything else locked and unreachable.
Raw node graphs from callers are structurally impossible.
mutate route class on Ollama fences is hard-blocked by the system regardless of UI state.

operatorMode.name: AppSidebar
operatorMode.desc: Full 228px nav (dashboard 8a) or 54px icon rail (detail screens). MM logo tile (sage gradient), section items, active = sage-tint bg. Footer: health pill + operator identity.

operatorMode.name: PageHeader
operatorMode.desc: 54–56px bar: title + mono subtitle; right-aligned actions (search ⌘K, time range, primary button). On 8b: breadcrumb + breed chip + exposed count + Discard/Save.

operatorMode.name: StatTile
operatorMode.desc: Card (#1c1714, border #2e2620, r9): mono uppercase label, 26px semibold value, trailing accent, footer (bar segments / sparkline / sub text).

operatorMode.name: DataTable
operatorMode.desc: Bordered card; header row #1c1714 mono-uppercase; body rows via display:grid contents, dividers #241d19. Right-aligned numerics. Used by Flocks, Keys, Usage.

operatorMode.name: BreedChip
operatorMode.desc: Mono 10px pill: ollama = sage tint, comfyui = warm-brown tint.

operatorMode.name: Drawer
operatorMode.desc: Right sheet 420px over scrim rgba(10,8,7,.55). Header + form + sticky footer (Cancel / primary). Flocks connect (9a).

operatorMode.name: Modal
operatorMode.desc: Centered 520px card over scrim rgba(10,8,7,.62), r12, heavy shadow. Icon header, body, footer. Key shown-once (9d).

operatorMode.name: FormField
operatorMode.desc: Mono 11px label + control (border #3a2f28, bg #141110, r7). Variants: text, url (mono), select (⌄), segmented toggle (Yes/No), switch.

operatorMode.name: NodeCard
operatorMode.desc: paramSchema editor (8b) graph node: header (mono #id in warm-brown + class_type + count/label), input rows with Locked/Exposed chip + promoted name. Selected node = sage border + 3px sage glow ring.

operatorMode.name: ParamInspector
operatorMode.desc: Right panel of 8b: type chip, Display name, Max length / min-max, Required segmented toggle.

operatorMode.name: ConsumerFormPreview
operatorMode.desc: Live caller contract card: Prompt textarea + char counter, Steps slider (sage fill + knob), Seed auto note, Run + View JSON.

operatorMode.name: RouteClassRow
operatorMode.desc: Fence (9c): label + description + switch. mutate variant = terracotta-tint, 🔒, forced off, explanatory copy.

operatorMode.name: AllowlistChip
operatorMode.desc: Model chip (sage tint) with ✕ remove; dashed '+ add' chip.

operatorMode.name: BlastRadiusCard
operatorMode.desc: Sage-tint summary card: plain-language recap of what callers can do.

operatorMode.name: BarChart
operatorMode.desc: Usage (10a): flex bars, sage default, warm-brown to flag an anomalous bucket, mono weekday labels.

operatorMode.name: AuditRow
operatorMode.desc: time (mono) + action dot + action verb (colored) + target + actor + expand ⌄. Expanded = mono detail card (actor/target/reason/ip). Day group headers.

operatorMode.name: SecretReveal
operatorMode.desc: Shown-once (9d): warning banner (terracotta), mono key + Copy, scope chips (✓ granted), 'I've saved it' checkbox gating Done.

metaBoy.name: DeviceShell
metaBoy.desc: Plum gradient body, asymmetric radius (22/22/84/22), inset highlights + drop shadow. Top ridge label strip (dashed rule).

metaBoy.name: Bezel
metaBoy.desc: Dark inner frame (r 14/14/40/14) with power LED (sage ok / terracotta alarm) + model text.

metaBoy.name: Lcd
metaBoy.desc: Radial pea-green surface + glow ring; children painted in ink #5f3336; scanline + vignette overlays at z-index 2.

metaBoy.name: LcdTitleStrip
metaBoy.desc: Solid ink bar, Press Start 2P title, cream text, right-side status glyphs (♥2/3, credits, clock).

metaBoy.name: LcdPanel
metaBoy.desc: 2px hard-ink bordered region with ink header bar; body rows divided by grid-line #b0a95e. No radius (pixel look).

metaBoy.name: PixelButton
metaBoy.desc: Ink-filled or outlined block, Press Start 2P label, optional text glow. A/B primary/secondary.

metaBoy.name: LcdSlider
metaBoy.desc: Bordered track, sage fill, square ink knob, min/max labels.

metaBoy.name: UploadSlot
metaBoy.desc: Dashed ink dropzone (diagonal hatch), ⇪ glyph; uploaded chip with sage ✓.

metaBoy.name: Dpad / ABButtons / Speaker
metaBoy.desc: Decorative controls: recessed #221619 cross, warm-brown radial A/B (rotated -25deg), 4 speaker slats.

metaBoy.name: RejectionToast
metaBoy.desc: Error state (7b): terracotta-accented card over dimmed+scrimmed editor; payload rows with ✓/✕, reason, actions.

state.flocks: Flock[] with live healthOk; drawer form {name, breed, baseUrl, upstreamAuth?, tlsTrust}; testConnection() -> {ok, latencyMs, version}
state.paddocks: Paddock[]; create form {flockId, name, slug}; derived publicUrl = origin + '/p/' + slug
state.fence: { constraintJson: {routeClasses, models}, rateLimit, quota }; mutate always false+disabled
state.apiKeys: ApiKey[]; create returns full key ONCE {plaintext, scope: paddockId[]}; store hash only
state.usage: rows keyed by (keyId, paddockId, dimension) over time buckets

interactions.intent: Paste/upload raw ComfyUI graphJson; parse to nodes. Nothing exposed until promoted.
Promote selected input to a ParamSpec (type inferred: string->text, number->number, seed->seed, image->image).
Remove ParamSpec; input reverts to locked.
Set name / required / max / min-max; reflects live in ConsumerFormPreview.
Probe baseUrl+auth; show ok/latency/version or error.
Persist constraintJson + rateLimit + quota. mutate stays hard-off.
Create key; open SecretReveal once with plaintext + scope.
Filter by key / paddock / time range.
Filter by action / actor; expand row for detail.
Submit promoted params to /p/:slug; render result. Consumer-facing.
Operator selects plain vs MetaBoy skin PER PADDOCK for its playground.
